You'll typically need your tracking ID (or application reference number) and date of birth to check the status.

list.snippet: VFS Global: If you submitted your application at a VFS Global Visa Application Centre, you can track it on their website using your tracking ID and date of birth.

Canada.ca: If you applied online through the IRCC portal, you can check the status on the Canada.ca application status tracker. You will need to sign in to your account to view your application status.
